# City of Kennewick, Washington

> Official website for the City of Kennewick, WA providing government services, community information, and civic engagement resources.

Go2Kennewick is the primary digital hub for residents and businesses to access city services, government information, utilities management, parks and recreation, and community updates. The site is built on the CivicPlus platform and serves as the central point for civic engagement, permit applications, bill payments, and emergency alerts.

## Key Topics

- City of Kennewick
- City Government
- City Services
- Emergency Services
- Parks and Recreation
- Economic Development
- Utility Billing
- Permits and Licenses
- Community Programs
- City Council
- Public Records
- Housing Assistance
- Civic Alerts
- Fire Department
- Police Department

## Core Government & Services

- [Kennewick, WA | Official Website](https://go2kennewick.com): Official homepage for City of Kennewick with news, services, and community information
- [Your Government | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/27/Your-Government): City government structure, council, manager, departments, and boards directory
- [City Services | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/101/City-Services): Comprehensive directory of Kennewick city services and community resources
- [How Do I... | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/9/How-Do-I): How-to guides for permits, licenses, services, billing, and public records

## Public Safety & Emergency Services

- [Fire Department | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/149/Fire-Ambulance): Kennewick Fire Department services, safety info, and community programs
- [Police Department | Kennewick, WA](https://www.go2kennewick.com/1491/Police-Department): Kennewick Police Department services, safety programs, and crime prevention
- [What Happened to Sofia? | Kennewick, WA](https://www.go2kennewick.com/1368/What-Happened-to-Sofia): Missing child case information and community safety alert about Sofia Juarez

## Utilities & Billing

- [Utility Information | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/752/Utilities): Utility services information for water, sewer, gas, and billing options
- [Pay | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/678/Pay): Online payment portal for utility bills and city services

## Community & Recreation

- [Our Community | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/31/Our-Community): Community overview with facts, attractions, schools, and relocation information
- [Parks and Recreation | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/420/Parks-Recreation): Parks, recreation facilities, events, and activity registration for residents
- [Columbia River Dog Park | Kennewick, WA](https://www.go2kennewick.com/1640/15550/Columbia-River-Dog-Park): Information about Columbia River Dog Park facilities, rules, and pet amenities

## Economic Development & Business

- [Economic Development | Kennewick, WA](https://www.go2kennewick.com/1493/Economic-Development): Business resources, community profile, property info, and economic opportunities
- [Economic Development | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/397/Economic-Development): Business opportunities, community profile, and economic development resources

## Civic Engagement & Notifications

- [Council Meeting Broadcasts | Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/1256/Council-Meeting-Broadcasts): Live and archived city council meeting broadcasts and agendas
- [Notify Me • Kennewick, WA • CivicEngage](https://go2kennewick.com/list.aspx): Notification preferences and alert subscription management for city updates
- [News Flash • Kennewick, WA](https://go2kennewick.com/CivicAlerts.aspx): Civic alerts and news updates about community events and city programs
